SELECT SERVICE_CENTER_NO, SERVICE_CENTER_TITLE,
SERVICE_CENTER_READ_COUNT,
SERVICE_CENTER_CONTENT,
SERVICE_CENTER_CONTENT,
CASE WHEN SYSDATE - SERVICE_CENTER_WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 / 60 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - SERVICE_CENTER_WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60 * 60 ) || '초 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - SERVICE_CENTER_WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - SERVICE_CENTER_WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60) || '분 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - SERVICE_CENTER_WRITE_DATE < 1 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - SERVICE_CENTER_WRITE_DATE) * 24) || '시간 전'
ELSE TO_CHAR(SERVICE_CENTER_WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY.MM.DD') END SERVICE_CENTER_WRITE_DATE
FROM "SERVICE_CENTER" WHERE SERVICE_CENTER_DEL_FL = 'N' AND SERVICE_CENTER_CODE = #{typeNo} ORDER BY SERVICE_CENTER_NO DESC

SELECT SERVICE_CENTER_NO, SERVICE_CENTER_TITLE, SERVICE_CENTER_CONTENT,
CASE WHEN SYSDATE - SERVICE_CENTER_WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 / 60 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - SERVICE_CENTER_WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60 * 60 ) || '초 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - SERVICE_CENTER_WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - SERVICE_CENTER_WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60) || '분 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - SERVICE_CENTER_WRITE_DATE < 1 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - SERVICE_CENTER_WRITE_DATE) * 24) || '시간 전'
ELSE TO_CHAR(SERVICE_CENTER_WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY.MM.DD') END SERVICE_CENTER_WRITE_DATE
FROM "SERVICE_CENTER" WHERE SERVICE_CENTER_DEL_FL = 'N' AND SERVICE_CENTER_NO = #{serviceCenterNo} ORDER BY SERVICE_CENTER_NO DESC

SELECT I.INQUIRY_TITLE , I.INQUIRY_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(I.INQUIRY_ENROLL_DATE, 'YYYY.MM.DD') "INQUIRY_ENROLL_DATE", I.INQUIRY_STATUS, IMAT.INQUIRY_MAJOR_CATEGORY_NAME, IMIT.INQUIRY_MINOR_CATEGORY_NAME, M.MEMBER_EMAIL
FROM INQUIRY_ONE_ON_ONE I
JOIN INQUIRY_MAJOR_CATEGORY_TYPE IMAT
ON(I.INQUIRY_MAJOR_CATEGORY = IMAT.INQUIRY_MAJOR_CATEGORY_CODE)
JOIN INQUIRY_MINOR_CATEGORY_TYPE IMIT
ON(I.INQUIRY_MINOR_CATEGORY = IMIT.INQUIRY_MINOR_CATEGORY_CODE AND I.INQUIRY_MAJOR_CATEGORY = IMIT.INQUIRY_MAJOR_CATEGORY_CODE)
JOIN "MEMBER" M ON (I.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO)
WHERE M.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
ORDER BY I.INQUIRY_NO DESC
